comments.author: Nour
comments.body:
It can now be used in a new dish, guess what it is?

It is French Fries. (Idk real name ig because i never made it before, but it is potatoes cut and fried.)

In the recipe, you need 1 Potato, 1 Salt, and 1 Vegetable Oil with r6 Cooking.

Now, GO, and make us McDonald's Fries!!

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Good find. Checked out your find on the J-Wiki...

gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=4907

Seems the dish in question ("Fritz", according to Google Translate, but that's just another way of saying Fries) restores 30 vigor, and can be used in two other recipes, one of which is apparently R16 Cooking (Gyros) fleet food which restores 85 vigor/-51 fatigue. Not sure if two other recipes are in the game yet, and can't really check... I'm sure someone will chime in if they find out that's the case, though.
